MATERIAL.definition: A substance, composition, or material system considered as matter.

DEVICE.definition: An engineered object or functional physical component with a technical role.

PROPERTY.definition: A physical, chemical, structural or manufacturing attribute or parameter of a bearer.

PERFORMANCE.definition: A capability, task outcome or evaluation measure in an application.

ANALYTE.definition: A substance or explicit substance class in the contextual role of target, adsorbate or comparison gas.

PROCESS.definition: A technical action, transformation, operation or event, including formation and measurement.

MECHANISM.definition: A source-expressed explanation, interaction, or combined explanatory account of technical behavior.

OPERATING_CONDITION.definition: An environmental, sample or operating circumstance under which a claim applies.

MORPHOLOGY.definition: A structural arrangement, shape, geometry or electronic/spatial feature.

TECHNOLOGY.definition: A named technology or method family referenced as an approach.

APPLICATION.definition: An explicitly named end use, task or application field.

OTHER.definition: A source-expressed technical referent that does not fit the other kinds.

HAS_PROPERTY.definition: The bearer has the stated non-task physical, chemical, structural or process attribute.

HAS_PERFORMANCE.definition: The bearer exhibits the stated task capability, measured outcome or performance limitation.

HAS_MORPHOLOGY.definition: The bearer has a stated structural, geometric or electronic arrangement.

HAS_COMPONENT.definition: The composite or device explicitly contains the physical material or functional component.

HAS_MEMBER.definition: An explicitly expressed collection has the listed member; this does not distribute the collection claim to its members.

USES_MATERIAL.definition: A device explicitly employs a material in its construction or functioning.

FUNCTIONS_AS.definition: A material explicitly serves as the named functional component or role.

DETECTS.definition: The sensor has an explicitly stated detection capability for the target substance, including explicit nonresponse and prospective capability.

USED_FOR.definition: The object has an explicitly stated actual, proposed or hypothetical application, process use or material sensing target.

FABRICATED_BY.definition: The object is obtained by the stated fabrication process, within the source modality.

IMPROVES.definition: The process is stated to make a property or task outcome better in the source-defined evaluative sense.

ACTS_ON.definition: The process explicitly acts on, characterizes, transforms or otherwise operates on the object.

INTEGRATED_IN.definition: The functional object is explicitly incorporated into the receiving host.

HAS_MECHANISM.definition: The device or material has the stated source-expressed mechanism for its specified behavior.

MECHANISM_INVOLVES.definition: The mechanism explicitly involves the named subordinate mechanism, process or structure.

LOCATED_IN.definition: The electronic or geometric structure is explicitly situated in the named material.

OPTIMIZES.definition: A process explicitly adjusts an object or configuration described as optimized or optimal for a stated technical objective.

FACILITATES.definition: A material or process promotes or enables the named process without asserting strict production of its outcome.

CAUSES.definition: A source explicitly states that the causal factor produces or induces the named technical event; event endpoints remain events.

EXPLAINS.definition: The source attributes an observed or proposed technical outcome or process to the explanatory factor, with the stated contribution and scope.

CHANGES_PARAMETER.definition: A factor changes or explicitly leaves unchanged the target physical/property or performance parameter; direction describes that parameter, not desirability.

DEPENDS_ON.definition: The source explicitly states that the head quantity/outcome depends on the tail parameter or structural configuration; no functional law is inferred.

MEETS_REQUIREMENT.definition: The material/device meets, or explicitly fails to meet, a jointly specified requirement bundle.
MEETS_REQUIREMENT.direction: evaluated bearer -> explicit joint requirement bundle
